messages:
Grace (Docs): Heads-up: found stale snippets and two broken links in function/tool-calling + structured-output docs. Opening a focused PR to consolidate examples and add a short migration note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7925

Ravi (SDK): I can update TS snippets. Which files?

Grace (Docs): `docs/tool-calling.md`, `docs/structured-output.md`, `examples/ts/func_calling.ts`, `examples/py/func_call.py`. Also migrate examples from `tool_output` -> `output`.

Marta (Eng): On schema changes: propose example schema use `output: { result: string }` and add `additionalProperties: false` to catch stray keys. Will draft a patch.

Noah (PM): Product prefers compact examples. Keep the new examples as default and add a short legacy example showing `tool_output` -> `output` migration.
docs-bot: PR #7925 opened by @Grace — CI: lint OK, link-checker flagged 1 dead link.

Ravi (SDK): Reviewing now. I will update method names (`callTool` -> `invoke`) and types (`InvokeResponse` -> `InvokeResult`) in the TS snippet and include comments for streaming vs non-streaming paths.

Marta (Eng): Schema PR drafted and linked from #7925. Added migration note: "If your code consumes `tool_output`, replace with `output` and validate with `additionalProperties: false` to detect shape regressions."

Grace (Docs): I'll fix the dead link and add a docs- CI test that validates JSON examples render and conform to schemas. Target merge tomorrow AM. Tag me in PRs if anything blocks.

Ravi (SDK): ACK — will sign off after addressing two small comments about import paths.

Marta (Eng): ACK — ETA EOD.

Grace (Docs): Updated PR and fixed link. Planning to merge once reviews are complete. Thanks all!"
